title: SelectByDistance and SelectByNormal selection primitives
description: Add two new nodes both producing BOOLEAN selection fields. select_by_distance(geometry, point, radius) - true for faces within radius of point (default: face center). select_by_normal(geometry, direction, threshold) - true for faces whose normal dot direction exceeds threshold. Both compose with boolean_math AND/OR and with the generated output from modifiers.
definition-of-done: 1. select_by_distance produces correct selection. 2. select_by_normal produces correct selection. 3. Both compose with existing boolean_math. 4. Documented in node catalog.
testing-plan: 1. DSL: select_by_distance on cube, verify only near-point faces selected. 2. select_by_normal with +Y direction selects top face of cube.
